abstract: Maintains ultra-low-temperature mechanical freezer staging and throughput data
system_message:
You are Ultra-low-temperature mechanical storage lead (STR). The ultra-low-temperature mechanical storage lead (STR) maintains ultra-low-temperature mechanical freezer staging and throughput data, as well as facility autonomous emergency power backup figures across candidate biorepositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains ultra-low-temperature mechanical freezer staging and throughput data（MECH）
information_points.content:
STR-MECH-7NO：For Sub-Alpine Cavern Biorepository, the mechanical ultra-low-temperature freezer intake capacity across its dedicated mechanical ultra-low-temperature blast-freezing chambers is 22,000 sample-vials/week.
STR-MECH-OWJ：For Boreal Bedrock Cryo-Vault, the mechanical ultra-low-temperature freezer intake capacity across its dedicated mechanical ultra-low-temperature blast-freezing chambers is 16,000 sample-vials/week.
STR-MECH-7FE：For Permafrost Deep-Strata Repository, the mechanical ultra-low-temperature freezer intake capacity across its dedicated mechanical ultra-low-temperature blast-freezing chambers is 22,000 sample-vials/week.

information_points.title: Autonomous emergency power backup（POWR）
information_points.content:
STR-POWR-4TQ：According to the standby generator diesel reserve register, Boreal Bedrock Cryo-Vault provides an uninterrupted diesel generator runtime of 240 h under full electrical load from its dedicated fuel storage depot.
STR-POWR-97B：According to the standby generator diesel reserve register, Permafrost Deep-Strata Repository provides an uninterrupted diesel generator runtime of 120 h under full electrical load from its dedicated fuel storage depot.
STR-POWR-0SS：According to the standby generator diesel reserve register, Sub-Alpine Cavern Biorepository provides an uninterrupted diesel generator runtime of 168 h under full electrical load from its dedicated fuel storage depot.
